newsitem.title: USA: US spot MTBE pulled down by NYMEX.
newsitem.headline: US spot MTBE pulled down by NYMEX.

text.p: U.S. spot MTBE prices were pulled down in quiet trade Thursday by falling NYMEX gasoline futures and weaker values on gasoil, traders said.
Some players said trade was light as many buyers sat on the sidelines waiting for MTBE to fall lower should the decline in NYMEX continue.
"I think MTBE can go down further," said a Houston buyer.
In the U.S. Gulf Coast, Houston spot MTBE was valued Thursday between 88.50 cents and 89.00 cents a gallon, about 1.25 cents below last week's values.
A high of 89.75 cents was traded early in the week before the fall in NYMEX, traders said. An 88.75 cent parcel for any October was heard sold Wednesday.
In the East Coast, New York Harbor spot MTBE dipped one cent to 90.00/92.00 cents, but Mobil was heard offering 90.50 cents to catch possible takers loading for West or East Coast markets.
Meanwhile, the prices for MTBE feedstocks, such as methanol and normal butane, remained fairly constant this week.
